data_gaps: No direct Google Maps access was used, so Google star ratings and review counts were not verified at source for any business in this batch.
He's Health Center Spa, Bella's Nail Salon and Healing Hands Massage Therapy: overall average rating was not displayed on the BestProsInTown pages opened.
M J Hair Salon has no first-party site and neither it nor Reny's publishes prices, so service lists and price levels are inferred from directories and menu labels.
LX Factory: no website found; whether it has its own Google Business Profile (beyond Booksy) is unverified.
Forever Beauty: the Fresha review counts (about 913 at South River and 837 at New Brunswick) were read from Fresha's South River listing sidebar, not from each venue page's review widget.
foreverbeautynj.com is a Wix site with no contact form, so no form was tested; its BOOK NOW path goes to Fresha and was not driven to a confirmation screen.
Dermabright's Square menu cards rendered as skeleton placeholders for several seconds before loading, so reliability on slow connections is uncertain.
No business in this batch was contacted; nothing was submitted, booked or messaged.
